intro: Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan wants the Wastewander water pouches the nomads stole, wherever you find them out in the desert. The Gadgetzan Water Company offers an official care package in return for each five.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings friend - the name's Luglunket, and we've got an important job for you if you're up for it! Huzzah!

Nothing would please me more as a seasoned spigot operator to take any Wastewander water pouches you might find out in the desert. That's our water anyway - the nomads have just stolen it is all! The Gadgetzan Water Company will offer you an official care package for every five you turn in. Most importantly though, you're helping Gadgetzan help itself!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Got the five Wastewander water pouches we need? If you do, then the Gadgetzan Water Company Care Package, Model 103-XB, will be yours!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent - the more water pouches we are able to reclaim, the further away from disaster we'll all be! Keep 'em coming, and I will be sure to reward you for every five water pouches you bring me.
